messages:
yara: starting canary for v2.6.2 -> embed-eu switches to modelx:quant-opt at 15:03 UTC
deploy-bot: Canary 0%->100% in 5m. details: https://deploys.redwood.internal/5987612345 :robot_face:
tom: quick flag - synth prefill p95 on eu-west1 jumped 90ms -> 360ms at +3m. no user errors but tail up.
oncall: runbook: hold if synth p95 > 300ms for >90s and kv-miss delta >8%
yara: kv-miss delta +11% here. recommend regional pinback to fp16 for eu-west1 only.
smoke-bot: triggered embed-kv-prefill rerun in eu-west1, ETA 35s
smoke-bot: pre-pin p95 362ms, kv-miss +11% ; post-pin p95 118ms, kv-miss +1% :white_check_mark:
yara: applied rdctl pin for region eu-west1 to modelx:fp16. config bumped.
tom: filing tracker ticket PERF-2309 for quant-opt warmup ordering and prefetch priority.
oncall: leaving global rollout paused for 20m observation. add short release note that eu-west1 was pinned back due to synthetic prefill tail.
yara: noted in release: "v2.6.2: temporary regional pin in eu-west1 to fp16 after synthetic prefill latency increase; investigating quant-opt warmup behavior."
